name: Small overruns come out of a pool
title: Small overruns come out of a pool
story: The theory first: a card that cannot pay for one more session asks; below full auto the person decides, at autonomous and full auto the project agent may fund it from a monthly pool inside set limits, and anything beyond them reaches the person. Then the console: a card stops at €0.40, the factory wakes the agent, it funds €0.60 from the pool, and the card goes on.
